'''Stayer''' is one of the horses owned by [[Perrin Aybara]].

==Appearance==
Stayer is a bay horse with white forefeet.

==Activities==
Stayer was appropriated, unnamed, by Perrin Aybara from the [[Sun Palace]] stables in [[Cairhien]]. When Perrin leaves the [[Cairhien (city)|city]] to search for [[Rand al'Thor]], he takes the horse and, after some small consideration, names him Stayer.{{ref/book|6|54}} The horse travels with Perrin into [[Ghealdan]].{{ref/book|8|9}} Stayer carries Perrin to a meeting with [[Masema Dagar]] in [[Abila]],{{ref/book|9|2}} and later into [[So Habor]].{{ref/book|10|25}} Stayer also carries Perrin into [[Almizar]] so that he and his [[Seanchan]] allies might acquire ''[[raken]]'', [[forkroot]] and ''[[a'dam]]'' to help rescue [[Faile Bashere]] from the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]].{{ref/book|11|12}}
